comparisonExisting.informant: Preserve V01. Already brown-skinned, layered green/ochre/red cloth, but closer to generic Arena citizen broad collar than Alik’r linen wrapping. Distinction is variety to assess, not a defect or automatic replacement. Static south only remains its existing scope.
comparisonExisting.blubamka: Preserve V01 blue/burgundy royal robe and circlet. Less wrapped textile than supplied civil references, appropriate possible occupational variation. Wiki Arena_People p3 identifies her as female Redguard; individual face/robe remain artistic interpretation. Historical generation prompt not rewritten. Do not require all Redguards to wear turbans or copy the queen to civilians.
